intent.proves: At least one completed, non-deleted order exists.
intent.scope: all orders excluding quotes, ledger entries and subscription base orders

bindings.reason: search_orders takes a request object and pages; a complete-enumeration handler with this filter is not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomOrders WHERE OrderComplete = 1 AND ISNULL(OrderDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderIsQuote, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderIsLedgerEntry, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderIsRecurringOrderTemplate, 0) = 0
